subject: Post-discovery: tech deep-dive pre-read, infra questions & slot options
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Reddy <samir@quasarhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Sep 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: tech deep-dive pre-read, infra questions & slot options

Hi Samir / Leah —

Thanks again for the discovery yesterday. The team walked away with a clear understanding of Quasar Health's primary goals (low-latency triage scoring, tenant isolation, and strict audit trails). To make our technical deep-dive efficient, I put together a short pre-read and a couple of architecture questions for your platform team so the session can be productive.

Quick asks:
- Please review the attached pre-read (RI_tech-pre-read-v1.pdf) — it outlines the topics we plan to cover and a proposed agenda (30–40 min demo + 30 min infra Q&A + 10 min next steps).
- If possible, share approximate RPS and peak concurrency for the triage pipeline and whether you plan to host inference in cloud (GCP/AWS) or hybrid/on-prem.

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Thu Sep 2, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Sep 2, 14:00–15:00
- Fri Sep 3, 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, please propose 2 windows that work for your infra leads — or pick from my Calendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/marissa-30m.

Attaching a topology diagram we may reference in the deep-dive (inference-topology-diagram.png).

Looking forward —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Reddy <samir@quasarhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Turner <leah.turner@quasarhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: tech deep-dive pre-read, infra questions & slot options

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the notes and the pre-read — looks great. A few quick answers while Leah loops in our infra lead:
- We expect ~120 RPS during peak hours today, spikes up to 230 RPS for short bursts.
- The current deployment is primarily GCP (us-west1) with a small on-prem pool for PHI-sensitive workloads.

We can do Thu Sep 2, 14:00–15:00 PDT — that works for product + infra. Quick question: do you recommend pre-provisioning GPUs for the session if we want a demo that mirrors production?

Best,
Samir

--
Samir Reddy
VP Product, Quasar Health
samir@quasarhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Reddy <samir@quasarhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: tech deep-dive pre-read, infra questions & slot options

Perfect — Thu 2 Sep, 14:00–15:00 PDT is tentatively booked on our side.

Samir — brief note on provisioning: for a production-faithful demo we can either:
1) Run the demo against a small dedicated GPU instance (recommended for realistic latency numbers), or
2) Use a cached prefix + smaller instance to demonstrate flow but not exact p99 latency.

Ben / Rishi / Soojin — can you confirm whether we have a spare T4/RTX-like instance available in us-west1 for Thu 2 Sep 14:00 PDT? If not, we'll do a cached-flow demo and call out differences. Also flag any additional artifacts we should circulate ahead of time (post-discovery checklist, SSO/SAML notes).

Samir — I'll send calendar invite once Ben confirms infra. Also attaching the drive link to the pre-read for your team: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Cpre-read-Quasar

Thanks —
Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 2 Sep 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: tech deep-dive pre-read, infra questions & slot options

Marissa — we have a spare RTX A5000 in us-west1 for Thu 2 Sep 14:00 PDT but it is reserved for a different customer until 13:00. I can spin it up and ensure it's warmed by 13:30, but would want to run a short smoke test at 13:45 to confirm kernels/quantization flags.

Rishi — can you put together the 10-min smoke checklist (model artifact path, quantization flags we'll set, test prompt set) and drop it here? Soojin — I'll need your help with the demo script so we call out where caching will affect numbers.

If for any reason the instance isn't ready by 13:45, we'll revert to the cached-flow variant and mark numbers as demonstrative.

Cheers,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: tech deep-dive pre-read, infra questions & slot options

Marissa / Team — thanks, confirmed. We had one calendar conflict pop up for an infra lead, so can you please shift the meeting by 30 minutes to 14:30–15:30 PDT on Thu Sep 2? The rest of our stakeholders can make 14:30.

If shifting is a problem for you, we can keep 14:00 and have our infra lead join the first 20 minutes remote/phone. Otherwise 14:30 works best.

Also confirming we'll upload a short network topology doc by EOD today to the shared drive — should help with the firewall questions.

Leah

--
Leah Turner
Head of Integrations, Quasar Health
leah.turner@quasarhealth.com | +1 312-555-0172
